title: Ely's Automatic Housemaid
author: Elizabeth W. (Elizabeth Whitfield) Bellamy
longDescription: Bellamy is a satirical science fiction story written in the late 19th century.

authorInfo.bio: Elizabeth W. (Elizabeth Whitfield) Bellamy (1837–1900) wrote Ely's Automatic Housemaid. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
